alternatives.problem: regular supported scalar targets are positive-only
alternatives.prospective_alternative: Cross actual supported numeric sign with support/missing/conflict and prompt style; distinguish latent metadata from visible evidence and gold.

alternatives.problem: prompt styles predict transition sign/branch or fact scenario
alternatives.prospective_alternative: Use the unadopted semantic-cell style assignment, preserve all world/evidence/semantic-gold identities, then re-render contract targets and repeat tokenizer audits.

alternatives.problem: all fresh conditional margins are zero or one
alternatives.prospective_alternative: Declare wider positive/negative comparison margins and held-out strata before generation, including an explicit tie stratum; keep modulo-97 support limitations separate.

alternatives.problem: difficulty changes parent worlds, gold signs and paired dependence
alternatives.prospective_alternative: Either report the current arms as bundled curricula, or prospectively construct common latent parent populations with matched case margins and paired units in both controls and treatments.

required_next_decision: Retain the reviewed bundled-recipe experiment with these disclosed input patterns, or explicitly version amended inputs and obtain new source/data review. No automatic replacement.

additional_source_only_finding.problem: Complete/incomplete wording predicts support under the current constructor
additional_source_only_finding.prospective_alternative: Cross complete/incomplete/neutral cue wording with factual support and style, preserving evidence and deterministic gold. Any paired cue evaluation projection needs prospective approval inside the existing prompt/call budget; no automatic expansion.

recommendation: Prepare and review a new prospective data version that removes the verified case/style/sign and cue shortcuts before admitting the full training sweep. Keep all eight recipes, seeds, training defaults, selection, final endpoints and cumulative budget unchanged unless a separate explicit design decision changes them.
preservation: Original inputs and the forty-file qualification source/proposal remain unchanged; no alternative is consumed by a native worker. Existing style maps require re-rendering and token/leakage review before use.
